title: Formation of Stacked Lateral Semiconductor Devices and the Resulting Structures (US 2021/0233767; family incl. US 12176209)
query: 3D DRAM single-crystal silicon lateral epitaxy into tunnels after nitride removal oxide/nitride stack instead of Si/SiGe superlattice
supports: Search summary attributes to a TC Lab patent family: alternating SiO2/SiN stack, stack cut, isotropic nitride removal, single-crystal Si formed in the cavities by confined epitaxial overgrowth (CEO) seeded from the substrate through slots; framed for stacked lateral thyristors/diodes, DRAM only as background. Exact assignee-to-URL mapping not confirmed. An older DRAM patent describing CLSEG for stacked cells also surfaced. No source applied the method to a 3D DRAM array (via search snippet)

title: NEO Semiconductor unveils 1T1C and 3T0C IGZO-based 3D X-DRAM technology
supports: NEO's IGZO 1T1C and 3T0C 3D X-DRAM cells, built with a 3D NAND-like process, are projected by TCAD only: >450 s retention, 10 ns read/write, up to 512 Gb. A proof-of-concept test chip was planned for 2026; no silicon data (via search snippet)
